source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 【During Test】 1. Bios Setting EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> Lock Chipset -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> Processor Configuration -> MSR Lock Control -> Disabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> EV DFX features -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Socket Configuration -> IIO Configuration -> IIO DFX Configuration -> Disable BIOS Done -> [‘X’] EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> WHEA Error Injection Support -> Enabled EDKII Menu -> Platform Configuration -> System Event Log -> Error Injection Settings -> Whea PCIE Error Injection Action Table -> Enabled 2. Deploy Intel ITP environment. 3. Boot SUT into Windows. 4. Execute Intel Cscripts on the client 5. Using the following command >>>itp.log("C:\Test.log") >>>halt() >>>pcie.topology() >>>pcie.port_map() 6. Check PCIe slot target >>>ei.injectPcieError(socket, port, errType='ce',) >>>go 【After Test】 1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders. 2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria_direct_xlsx: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie correctable error if there is one
source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- PCIe slot 1~N (Intel correctable ECC on PCIe slot 1~N error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'corrected|CE_|CE |EDAC|memory.error'; echo __correctable_ECC_on_PCIe_slot_1~N; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

test_case.test_name: PCIe slot 1~N — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: For every approved PCIe slot, inject one correctable PCIe error into the mapped root port and prove the intended AER/WHEA event occurs without link loss, device impairment, service disruption or fault-light assertion.
required_package: PCIe slot 1~N to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port map
Endpoint identity, driver/FW, active-use assessment and safe coverage list
Intel ITP/CScripts version/hash and injectPcieError CE semantics
Mandatory Windows/AER/WHEA status plus applicable BMC/UEFI and link/device health oracle
Abort, OOB recovery and BIOS restoration plan
test_case.test_command: The FAE reconciles physical slot, endpoint BDF, root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port using fresh topology captures, confirms the endpoint is idle or safely testable, performs one CE injection, and correlates Cscript status with Windows/AER, link/device health and applicable management logs before restoration.
test_case.expected_result: 1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie correctable error if there is one
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for PCIe slot 1~N. The protected Criteria is `1. System should work normally 2. BMC error log may record pcie correctable error 3. Front Panel fault Light will not Light if there is one 4. uEFI SEL Log may record pcie correctable error if there is one`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Reliability row 30 Wistron-System RAS-00750-V003: approve PCIe slot 1~N to endpoint/root-port BDF and Cscript socket/port coverage, ITP/CScripts version/hash and CE semantics; define mandatory Windows WHEA/AER/Cscript event signature when BMC/UEFI are optional, allowable link/device effects, endpoint quiesce rules, recovery and BIOS restoration.
safety_gate: Dedicated or quiesced endpoint with no management-path dependency
Fresh topology/port map; never infer socket/port from numbering
One CE injection per approved slot with before/after link and driver health
Abort on wrong target, link retrain/down, device reset, fatal escalation or service impact
No automatic retry; restore settings and verify every affected endpoint
expected_evidence: Endpoint identity, active-use precheck and package hash
Windows WHEA/AER PCIe CE plus link/device/driver health and applicable BMC/UEFI records
Front-panel off, settings restoration and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: The source's `may record` language cannot make every event optional. The approved Windows/Cscript PCIe-correctable evidence must be mandatory; BMC/UEFI applicability can remain platform-dependent.

source_conflict.reason: Slot 1~N has no physical-to-socket/port/BDF map or coverage list; BMC/UEFI logs are merely optional without another explicit primary event signature; Windows conflicts with dmesg; and DeepSeek looks for memory EDAC instead of PCIe AER evidence.
